name: Vessel CRM Contact
description: Structure of the unified CRM contact entity (v2).

fields.name: id
fields.description: Id of the object in the connected CRM.

fields.name: phone
fields.description: The primary phone number for this contact

fields.name: mobilePhone
fields.description: The primary mobile phone number for this contact. Possibly the same as the phone number.

fields.name: createdTime
fields.description: The timestamp that the contact was created

fields.name: modifiedTime
fields.description: The timestamp the contact was last modified
